expi.summary: Sole engineer for a fintech platform: architecture, implementation, infrastructure and releases.
highlights: Built a TypeScript, Nuxt and Nitro platform with service management, a customer portal, a product catalog and Telegram integrations.
Migrated PHP data and services in stages using ETL, parallel reads and reconciliation. Decoupled copy-trading workers from PHP; portal migration remained in progress.
Brought payments, recurring subscriptions, refunds and access provisioning into one billing flow, with payment-to-access reconciliation.
Rewrote copy-trading workers for Binance, Bybit and Finam with shadow runs, tests and a trading gate for database schema readiness.

Moved Matrix to a cloud worker with idempotent commands, broker reconciliation, leases and pausing on uncertain state. Prepared a paid subscription and public offer for launch; Matrix remained in production testing.
Established AI-assisted work through specifications, architectural decisions, review and CI; set up Forgejo. Enabled Docker build caching; a measured repeat build with a warm cache took 3 min 30 s.

sushilove.summary: Built internal services for a restaurant chain and improved its websites.
highlights: Connected PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ for background task processing.
Built a web application and Telegram Mini App for task assignment, statuses, deadlines and team/partner reporting.
Audited Bitrix and Tilda sites, fixed defects and improved page loading.

o5.summary: Built an online food-ordering platform used by 500+ business clients.
highlights: Rewrote the PHP/jQuery core in TypeScript, React and NestJS.
Moved deployments to Kubernetes and maintained product infrastructure.

berry.summary: Co-founded a web studio with a partner, handling estimates, development and client delivery.
highlights: Delivered 20+ retail and service websites, including forms, calculators and payment integrations.

freelance.summary: Started in custom web development, building corporate websites and online stores with PHP/jQuery.
highlights: Configured domains, DNS, MySQL and Apache/Nginx hosting, and maintained the delivered sites.
